verificationPage.verifiedSubtitle: You now have full verified-account privileges. A verification badge appears on your profile to build trust.
verificationPage.pageIntro: Verify your account to increase trust with buyers and sellers and unlock account features.
verificationPage.absherDescription: Absher is Saudi Arabia's national digital services platform. We are preparing a secure in-app path so you can verify your identity the same way you trust government-grade services — with careful integration, compliance checks, and testing before we enable it.
verificationPage.absherComingSoon: Absher verification is coming soon. We are building it with the same rigour used for national-scale digital identity rollouts.
verificationPage.absherComingSoonHint: The service is not live yet. We are working on it to that standard and will announce readiness on this page.
verificationPage.absherFooter: Your data will be handled with the same security and privacy rigour you expect from established digital identity programmes.
verificationPage.statusPendingBody: We received your documents and will update your account after review.
verificationPage.statusRejectedBody: You can submit again using the tabs below.
verificationPage.absherDialogLead: We are integrating with the national Absher ecosystem the same way regulated products ship: clear milestones, security review, and authorised channels only — before any live verification flow is switched on.
verificationPage.absherDialogBody: Absher verification through this app is in active development. We follow a careful rollout: integration hardening, privacy review, compliance alignment, and partner sign-off. You will start verification from this page when it is ready.
verificationPage.absherDialogPillar2: Security and privacy review aligned with national digital identity expectations
verificationPage.absherDialogPillar3: Compliance and operational readiness with identity-service partners
verificationPage.absherDialogPillar4: Staged testing and monitoring before public release
verificationPage.absherDialogFooterNote: This screen does not connect to Absher or send your national credentials until the integration is officially launched.

guarantee.requestFlowHint: Deposits and refunds require admin approval. You can still use in-app notices from support if your balance is low.

guarantee.requestRefundSubmitted: Refund request submitted. Pending admin approval.

guarantee.pendingRequestRefund: Refund request — waiting for admin approval.
guarantee.howItWorksP1: The financial guarantee is money you move from your wallet into a separate hold on the platform. It increases buyer trust when you sell inside the marketplace.
guarantee.howItWorksP2: The amount stays locked while you sell. When you stop selling and have no pending orders that need the hold, you can refund the full amount back to your available balance.
guarantee.howItWorksP3: If a buyer paid through the platform and you do not ship as agreed, the platform may use part of your held guarantee to compensate the buyer, after review. The exact process follows platform policies and dispute outcomes.
guarantee.sizingHintTitle: How much should I deposit? (guidance only)
guarantee.sizingHintBody: Think about your typical daily sales exposure. Example: if you might sell about 10 phones at 500 SAR each in a day, a 5,000 SAR hold illustrates the same order of risk. This is a planning hint, not a strict formula. When you have an active guarantee, buyers see a checkmark on your profile.
